segments.title: February
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! February. The shortest month, and the most romantic. Our theme pairs Valentine's with Stronger in 30, round two. Love is in the air, and so are a lot of very committed glutes.

segments.title: ₹1.83L
segments.text: So, the number. Our February target for Pop-up is 1.83 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent above last February. We're growing, and the plan knows exactly how.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 89,000 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 80,600, comebacks 11,800, and everything else 1,800. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 48 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 562 leads, 146 trials, and 48 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Roughly one in five trials becomes a member. Our job is to make it one in four.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 63,600 rupees, which is 35 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Couples Therapy (Cheaper Than the Real Thing)
segments.text: First up, Couples Therapy, cheaper than the real thing. Members bring someone new. The member gets ten per cent off, the guest gets fifteen, and both get a duo private. The only fight is over who holds the plank longer. The plan is 2 buyers at about 6,200, so 12,500 rupees.

segments.title: Situationship → Relationship
segments.text: Next, Situationship to Relationship. First-timers get fifteen per cent off their first month and a spot on the Stronger in 30 rookie track. Finish it, and they earn an extra week. Commitment never looked this good. The plan is 3 buyers at about 5,900, so 17,700 rupees.

segments.title: Galentine's Gone Ghost
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, Galentine's Gone Ghost. Come back with your best friend. You get fifteen per cent off, she gets two classes on us, and if she joins, matching grip socks and bonus days. The plan is 2 buyers at about 5,900, so 11,800 rupees.

segments.title: Proof of Work
segments.text: And finally, for the challengers, Proof of Work. Did thirty classes in thirty days? Your renewal price shows it. Six months at twenty per cent off, or an annual with an extra private. Receipts, not resolutions. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,200, so 21,700 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, launch the couples offers and open Stronger in 30. Week two, Valentine's week, so every member hears about bringing someone new. Week three, cheer the challengers on, because attendance is the pitch. Week four, everyone who finished thirty classes gets their Proof of Work price.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's February at Pop-up. 1.83 lakh rupees, four offers, and 48 buyers to welcome. Short month, long commitments. That's the dream.
